name: auto-handoff
description: Before a long chat is squeezed (compacted), writes a full handoff note and keeps it word for word, so nothing important is lost. /handoff makes one on demand.

folder.title: Handoff folder
folder.description: Where handoff notes are saved, relative to the chat's working folder.

warnAtPercent.title: Warn when the chat is this full (%)
warnAtPercent.description: Shows one short notice when the chat's memory passes this level.
